LNG Prime (Sept 2023) documents Equatorial Guinea back in FLNG talks with Golar LNG (Troim/Staubo Malabo visit 31 Aug 2023); no concrete progress reported since, which is the basis for GEM's inferred-shelved status. URL verified PASS via url_verifier (token 'Golar'). SINGLE-SOURCE after re-verify: the only independent echo of the Sept-2023 talks (guineainfomarket.com, Spanish, 4 Sept 2023) returns a persistent HTTP 500 and could not be verified, and the other Golar/EG hits (offshore-energy.biz) cover the unrelated 2015 First-Proposal Gimi contract, not the 2023 revival. Remaining support is the single LNG Prime article, hence confidence held at yellow. No gem.wiki citation used. 2024-2025 sweep searches surfaced no newer development, so the dormant status holds. The 2025 ShelvedYear/StopYear are purely inferential (~2 y after Sept 2023) with no source declaring a 2025 shelving, so those [ref] cells are left blank (see qa).
